Register a variable

Source: R/publish-variables.R
soil_register_variable.Rd

Declares a new variable that products may publish (an output of an external model, e.g. a soil-health score). The definition is first validated by the API (POST /variables/validate: the domain and the measurement kind must exist in the controlled vocabulary), then registered (POST /variables). Variables carry no unit: the hub mirrors its sources and converts nothing.

Usage

soil_register_variable(
  soil = soil_session(),
  variable_code,
  name,
  domain_code,
  value_type = c("numeric", "text", "boolean", "json"),
  measurement_kind_code,
  allowed_target_levels,
  description = NULL,
  idempotency_key,
  validate_only = FALSE
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

variable_code

Code of the variable: lowercase letters, digits and _ (e.g. "soil_health_physical_score"). API field variable_code.

name

Human name. API field name.

domain_code

Domain of the controlled vocabulary (e.g. "soil"). API field domain_code.

value_type

Type of the published values: "numeric", "text", "boolean" or "json". API field value_type.

measurement_kind_code

Measurement kind of the controlled vocabulary (e.g. "derived"). API field measurement_kind_code.

allowed_target_levels

Levels a value may be attached to, one or more of "feature", "profile", "component", "horizon". API field allowed_target_levels.

description

Optional description. API field description.

idempotency_key

Key of this registration (at most 200 characters), stable for one definition. API field idempotency_key.

validate_only

Only validate: nothing is registered. Client-side: stops after POST /variables/validate and skips POST /variables; not sent to the API.

Value

With validate_only = TRUE, the validation: a list valid, variable_code, errors (data frame). Otherwise the registered variable: a list variable_id, variable_code, name, description, domain_code, value_type, measurement_kind_code, allowed_target_levels (character), idempotent_replay. An invalid definition is a soilhub_validation_error whose errors lists the problems.

Details

Registration is idempotent: the same idempotency_key with the same definition returns the variable already registered (idempotent_replay = TRUE). A different definition under a key already used, or a variable_code already registered with another definition, is a soilhub_conflict_error (HTTP 409): choose a new key, or a new code.

Rights: soil:admin. Capability: variable_registration.

See also

Other writing: soil_product(), soil_product_version(), soil_publish_health(), soil_publish_source(), soil_publish_values(), soil_run_open(), soil_source_validate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil_register_variable(
  soil, "soil_health_physical_score", name = "Soil health, physical score",
  domain_code = "soil", value_type = "numeric",
  measurement_kind_code = "derived", allowed_target_levels = "horizon",
  idempotency_key = "var-soil-health-physical-v1"
)
} # }
